craft_notes: Sthāyin: anusvara-door (the meaning-door: all texts' meanings reach at the bindu — the most famous verse of the block: mātreṇānuśvāse — at the anusvara ALONE). Sanskrit: padārthāḥ sarvavedānām anusvāreṇa paryantam...striyā...amṛtadhārā → L4 keeps texts-meanings line 1, woman-seen-nectar-flow line 2. Rows: row 2 (in-so→nectar). Close: deer-eyed (vocative — the address returns at the nectar-verse: intimacy at the doors' climax). Rejected: 'punctuation mark' — killed: anusvara kept (the nasal-notation IS the door: the actual glyph-name); 'goddess' abstract — kept woman-seen (strī as seen: the image kept).

lines: Meanings all the texts' reached at anusvara:
as in so: woman-seen — nectar-flow, deer-eyed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is bondage here? → No bondage, no freedom — terrors are mere reflections, sun-in-water.
c1_essence: No bondage, no freedom: terrors reflections in water.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with śānta (wonder settled into stillness)
